Subject: On-call is moving to 3-day shifts on June 2

Hi team,

Starting June 2, on-call shifts will run for 3 days at a time instead of a full week. Shorter shifts should mean less burnout and more balanced weeks for everyone.

There are now 9 engineers in the on-call pool. Each shift you cover comes with a $150 bonus, as thanks for the work you put into keeping our systems running. We'll also write handoff notes at every changeover, so whoever picks up the next shift knows where things stand.

If you have questions, ask your team lead or post in #on-call.

Thanks,
The Engineering Leadership Team
